pages.en: Lily wants to paint a picture. She has red, yellow and blue paint. "I want more colours!" she says.
pages.zh: Lily 想画一幅画。她有红色、黄色和蓝色的颜料。“我想要更多颜色！”她说。
pages.scene: Lily at a little table with three paint pots, red, yellow and blue, a blank paper and a brush, looking thoughtful.

pages.en: Dad helps her. Yellow and blue make green. Red and yellow make orange. Red and blue make purple.
pages.zh: 爸爸帮她。黄色和蓝色调出绿色，红色和黄色调出橙色，红色和蓝色调出紫色。
pages.scene: Dad and Lily mixing paints on a palette, blobs of yellow and blue turning green, red and yellow turning orange, red and blue turning purple.

pages.en: Now Lily has lots of colours. She paints an orange sun, a green tree and a purple flower. It's a beautiful picture!
pages.zh: 现在 Lily 有好多颜色了。她画了橙色的太阳、绿色的树和紫色的花。真是一幅漂亮的画！
pages.scene: Lily proudly holding up her finished painting of an orange sun, a green tree and a purple flower, paint on her hands.

questions.q: Lily has red, yellow and blue paint.
questions.zh: Lily 有红色、黄色和蓝色的颜料。
